newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Kolinska 96 net down 13.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Kolinska 96 net down 13.9 pct.

text.p: Slovenian food maker Kolinska said on Tuesday its consolidated net profit in 1996 fell to 459.6 million tolars ($2.8 million) from 533.5 million a year ago, mainly due to a change in accounting procedures.

Kolinska chief executive Lojze Dezelak told Reuters that shareholders had approved payment of a dividend of 82.66 tolars ($0.51) per share, unchanged for the third year in a row, despite the fall in profit.
He said Kolinska's sales rose to 12.9 billion tolars in 1996 from 10.1 billion the previous year.
On Tuesday Kolinska's shares, which are listed on Ljubljana bourse, rose 2.69 percent or 63 tolars to 2,409 tolars on volume of 4,409 tolars.
